opportunities.name: Amber Grant for Women — monthly
opportunities.amount: 3 x $10,000 every month, plus annual $25,000 awards
opportunities.summary: The most frequently recurring grant on this board: three $10,000 awards every single month, deadline the last day of each month. One application enters you for the month and for the annual award. Low effort, genuinely repeatable — apply once and re-enter.
opportunities.eligibility: Women-owned businesses. $15 non-refundable application fee.
documents: Short online application describing the business and use of funds

opportunities.name: Buckeye State Credit Union Small Business Recovery Grant
opportunities.agency: Buckeye State Credit Union — CDFI Equitable Recovery Program
opportunities.summary: CLOSES 30 SEP — six days out, and the largest per-winner cheque anywhere on this board by a wide margin. A credit union rather than a foundation, funded from its own CDFI Equitable Recovery award, which is why the money is this size and this obscure. The two real gates are the two-year trading floor and a credible case that the funds serve an LMI or underserved population; the Akron priority is a tiebreak, not a bar. Applications are emailed to grantsupport@buckeyecu.org rather than submitted through a portal, so leave time for the attachments.
opportunities.eligibility: Minority-owned or minority-controlled as defined by federal guideline; trading at least two years; must show the funds benefit low-to-moderate-income or underserved communities. Credit union membership is NOT required and businesses outside Ohio may apply, though priority goes to Summit County and especially Akron.
documents: Completed Buckeye State CU application form (downloaded from the programme page)
Documentation of minority ownership or control
Evidence of at least two years of operation
A written plan showing how the funds benefit eligible communities

opportunities.summary: CONTEXT ROW, NOT AN APPLICATION. SBIR/STTR expired 30 Sep 2025 -- the longest lapse in 42 years. NIH cancelled 23 solicitations, NSF paused Project Pitch, DoD shelved topic lists, ~$4B stopped. Reauthorized 13 Apr 2026 (S.3971) through 30 Sep 2031, adding a Phase II strategic breakthrough vehicle with a $30M ceiling. From FY2027 each agency sets its own cap on how many proposals one company may submit -- so pick targets rather than carpet-bombing. Every state-match row on this board depends on holding a federal SBIR award first.
